raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (source_tz='UTC', 362 rows) stores txn_ts in UTC, while batches 1-13 (America/Chicago) store local time. Those UTC timestamps are read as local, shifting about 104 rows into 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00 and leaving 2026-01-18 undercounted. Converting UTC-sourced timestamps to America/Chicago local time, as the pipeline already assumes for other batches, should restore the expected time distribution and daily volumes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
